It emits exactly one warning, 'declaration uses sorry' at l.3392 (GX.exists_isLocalTamifying_charts, tagged SORRY(theo:local_virt_tame)), so REPORT's sorry_count 1 is right. The olean is newer than the source. AXIOMS: I ran #print axioms over all 202 declarations through `lake env lean --stdin`, which writes nothing. sorryAx reaches exactly exists_isLocalTamifying_charts, isVirtuallyTame_of_isXAManifold and local_virt_tame. Of the rest, 186 use propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, 8 use propext/Quot.sound and 5 use none. That covers every declaration under the 8 marked rows, the new descending chain (isVirtuallyTame_of_descending, local_virt_tame_descending, isLocalTamifying_descTop, descNhds_eq, IsChartDescent.exists_deck, nhds_descTop_le_of_aut, IsLiftableChartMap.isDescendingChartMap), the liftable chain and the cex chain. COVERAGE: the file's 202 declarations are exactly REPORT's decls + extra_decls. No name clashes with GX/ or the 23 other scaffold files. MARKS: bold labels are exactly REPORT's 8 marked rows; no partial row is bold. DIFF against Models.pre-fix-round1.lean.bak: purely additive in code (the Descent/DescTop/DescNat/DescChart/DescVirtTame sections, l.3682-4888); everything else is docstring/comment. No definition the earlier audits checked (IsTamifyingTopology, IsVirtuallyTame, IsLocalTamifying, IsXAManifold, the cex section) changed. SpreadTop.lean still typechecks against the new Models (exit 0, no output). AUDIT-1's major is RESOLVED, in substance of its preferred form. (1) The ℓ half of the restriction is gone. The new hypothesis IsDescendingChartMap (for all base points, every e over U and every f over φ(p e) admit a descent Ψ : V̂ ∋ f → Û ∋ e of φ⁻¹, continuous on V̂ with φ∘p∘Ψ = q) says only 'V̂ → V dominates Û → U'. It is implied by liftability (proved). It holds, informally by prop:universality and disclosed as such, when r : Ṽ → V̂ is an isomorphism with ℓ arbitrary. That covers the BTZ-type models the section is written for, where π₁(reg V) → π₁(reg X_α) is injective. (2) The ℓ-quotient is BUILT: descTop via mkOfNhds, with neighbourhoods Ψ(𝓝_{T_α} f), independent of the descent (descNhds_eq, via the Galoisianity of descents from the discreteness of the q-fibres, which is the model's local Galoisianity, used as the paper uses it at l.2093). All eight IsLocalTamifying fields are proved, naturality is proved, and isVirtuallyTame_of_descending is proved under ALL the theorem's hypotheses plus the descending one. (3) The remaining sorry is now correctly scoped to the non-descending charts, where the paper's T_{U,V,φ} needs r^*T_α. I re-read l.2086-2140. The proof's (D) there needs r⁻¹(R) portly for r^*T_α, which is lem:spread_top (c) for r. WP-27k's formal sector counterexample refutes (c) in general, and nothing in the theorem's hypotheses is shown to supply it. So the sorry rests on a gap in the paper's proof, not on unbuilt infrastructure, and CAMPAIGN.md allows a tagged sorry for such an obstruction. The sorried lemma is no stronger than the theorem: if M is virtually tame, the constant family T c := T satisfies it, via IsTamifyingTopology.isLocalTamifying, with trivial naturality. The row stays partial, honestly, and the master is asked for a ruling. DEC-67 (e) is applied (IsXAManifold.hasType; rem:singular_point_manifold_has closed by existsUnique_hasXAType). Under it the gluing gap at points centring no chart is gone (XAChart.eq_of_mem_centre + exists_aut_eq). DEC-69 is applied as ruled and is unchanged since AUDIT-1. Only minor issues remain, all disclosed.

issues.where: GX.IsDescendingChartMap (l.4668) and its docstring; checklist row 'theo:local_virt_tame, (ii) ⇒ (i)'; REPORT theo:local_virt_tame questions[1]
issues.problem: Three gaps in what is proved about IsDescendingChartMap. (1) The proved form's added hypothesis is about M, not the model alone: 'V̂ → V dominates Û → U'. The model-side sufficient condition 'r : Ṽ → V̂ an isomorphism ⇒ IsDescendingChartMap' is informal: it needs postcomposition of a branched covering by a base homeomorphism, maxBranched_universal and the Galoisianity of Ṽ → V. (2) No witness shows that IsDescendingChartMap is strictly weaker than IsLiftableChartMap. The only satisfiability witnesses are liftable charts (isLiftableChartMap_refl, isLiftableChartMap_modelChartSelf), so the 'ℓ arbitrary' gain over round 1 is argued, not exhibited. (3) The other model-side repair, StrongLocallyConnectedOrd for r^*T_α, is not stated; it would need Ṽ and r^*T_α built. Mathematically it is incomparable with the descending form, and through the paper's proof it covers non-descending charts. All three are disclosed in the docstrings (marked 'informal, not formalized'), in REPORT questions and in blocked_on. None affects the row's status, which is partial either way.
issues.fix: No package action required. A later package could add (a) the bridge lemma 'r iso ⇒ IsDescendingChartMap', so the proved form has a model-side corollary, and (b) one descending chart that is not liftable, for example a model whose local meridian survives in π₁(reg X_α) while M's Û is a finite quotient. Master: rule on the descending form (row closed under the ruling) or ask for the StrongLocallyConnectedOrd form.

issues.problem: Carried from WP-27j AUDIT-1/2/3 and WP-35f AUDIT-1. The dispatch asks for the global-equivalence reading. That reading is proved outright for the printed notion (forall_isTame_iff_printed), but for the DEC-67 (e) notion only under htype. The necessity of htype, and the falsity of the per-manifold iff, are argued in prose only. The library still contains no non-tame singular manifold (grep: no ¬ IsTame / not_isTame in GX/ or scaffold/), so DEC-27's counterexample cannot be formalized now. The row is honestly partial and the question is raised.
